english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road without windscreen washers fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with one or more windscreen wipers when it was not also fitted with a windscreen washer capable of cleaning the area of the windscreen swept by the wiper of mud or similar deposit
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 34(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a motor vehicle
on a road
fitted with one / more windscreen wipers
not fitted with a windscreen washer
capable of cleaning the windscreen

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 34(3),(4) and (5) for exceptions.
(ii) This requirement does not apply to rear window wipers/washers.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H196 and H197.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when no windscreen washer capable of cleaning the windscreen was fitted.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
